title: A look at AECJ, an Amazon employee group with over 1,000 members that is stepping up efforts to slow Amazon's data center expansion and spark debate over AI use (Rafe Rosner-Uddin/Financial Times)
summary: Rafe Rosner-Uddin / Financial Times: A look at AECJ, an Amazon employee group with over 1,000 members that is stepping up efforts to slow Amazon's data center expansion and spark debate over AI use — Tech company's plans for rapid expansion face opposition from the public and its own employees
